agreement_detail.both_sign_note: Omabili amaphakathi asayina, kungenjalo isivumelwano asisebenzi — irekhodi lenqaba inkontileka esebenzayoUma kukhona imisayina ekushodile.
agreement_detail.cosign_note_signed: Omunye uphakathi usayine. Isayina yakho yenza lesi sivumelwano sisebenze.
agreement_detail.cosign_note_unsigned: Isayina yakho izorekhodwa. Isivumelwano siyasebenza kuphela ngemuva kokuba omabili amaphakathi esayine.
agreement_detail.history_note: Leli thuluzi li-{status} — yimlando, futhi angeke kwaphinde kuxoxiswane ngalo.
agreement_detail.intro: Ithuluzi elilodwa, irekhodini: amaphakathi, imigomo, nemisayina yombili. Isisekelo salo angeke siphathwe phansi nayisiphi isiqinqatha.
agreement_detail.negotiation_note_after: — amaphakathi asayina kabusha umbhalo oshintshiwe. Asikho isiqinqatha esingasusa ilungelo lomthethosisekelo.
agreement_detail.negotiation_note_before: Imigomo engenhla iyisisekelo esivunyelwane. Ushintsho luphakanyiswa njengomugqa obomvu; lapho omunye uphakathi ekwamukela, kulungisa ithuluzi futhi
agreement_detail.parties_only: Lesi sivumelwano sibonakala kumaphakathi aso kuphela.
agreement_detail.review_before_sign: Buyekeza imigomo engenhla ngaphambi kokusayina egameni lika {name}.
agreement_detail.rights_body: Asikho isiqinqatha kulesi noma kunoma isiphi isivumelwano esingasusa, sidise, noma sisayine isuse ilungelo lomthethosisekelo — ukuvota, ukuba umkhethwa, ukuhlala, ukufaka isicelo, inqubo efanele. Isiqinqatha esizama lokhu asisebenzi kuleyo ngxenye; okunye kuyahlala. Akukho sivumelwano esingafaka imali noma izindleko ekusebenziseni ilungelo lomphakathi.
agreement_detail.title: Isivumelwano
agreements.group_org_hint: Izivumelwano nezinhlangano osebenza nazo noma owengxenye yazo.
agreements.group_resident_hint: Izivumelwano ozinikezile noma omenywe ukuba uzisayine.
agreements.intro: Buyekeza imigomo, izayina kanye nezinguquko eziphakanyiswe ezivumelwanweni ezitholakala kuwe.
agreements.terms_private_note: Imigomo yesivumelwano iyimfihlo. Izivumelwano zomsebenzi nokudayisa zivela lapho irekhodi lenqubo efanele lihambisana nayo.
agreements.title: Izivumelwano zami
exchange.intro: Thenga amasheya anikezwa abanye abaphethe, noma nikeza amakho ngamanani azimiselwe.
exchange.market_pointer_mid: ukubuyekeza ubuphathi nemali yawo. Impahla nezinto ezibhaliswe ziku-
exchange.no_currency_body: Isishayamthetho sokuqala salo mhlaba asizange sithumele okukodwa, ngakho akukho okubizwayo noma okuhwebwayo.
exchange.none_for_sale: Ayikho amasheya anikezwa ukudayiswa njengamanje. Ophethe ubhala amanye ngezansi; umthengi uthatha konke okunikezwe ngamanani azimiselwe — imali namayunithi kuhamba ndawonye noma akuhambi nhlobo.
exchange.offer_desc: Uphethe amalungelo ongawdayisa futhi. Bhala amanye ngamanani azimiselwe ngayunithi; umthengi uthatha konke okunikezwe. Ngeke unikeze okungaphezulu kwalokho ophethe
exchange.price_hint: Faka intengo engaphansi kwero zero enezindawo ze-decimal ezisithupha. Zero kwenza lokhu kube isipho.
exchange.quantity_hint: Faka inani elihamba phambili elinezindawo ze-decimal ezisithupha.
exchange.title: amasheya
help.intro: Cela usizo, nikeza isikhathi sakho noma amakhono akho, uvumelane nomuntu ngosizo aludingayo.
help.need_hint: Chaza umsebenzi, isikhathi nokuthi osizayo kufanele azi ini.
help.privacy_note: Izicelo zomphakathi zibonakala emakethe. Izimpendulo ziyimfihlo phakathi komcelile nomuntu ngamunye onikeza usizo. Ungashicilela udraft kamuva.
help.title: Nikeza futhi thola usizo
help_detail.accept_note: Ukukhetha lokhu kunqanda abanye abasizayo kule sicelo kuze kube yilapho kuphothulwe noma usizayo okhethiwe esusa isicelo.
help_detail.offer_hint: Chaza ukuthi yini ongayenza nokuthi nini. Nguwe kuphela nomcelile ongafunda le mpendulo.
help_detail.publish_note: Lolu draft lubonakala kuwe kuphela. Ukulishicilela kwenza isihloko nencazelo kubonakale emakethe yomphakathi ukuze abantu banikeze usizo.
help_detail.resolve_note: Maka njengokuphothulwe lapho usizo selunikezwe. Lokhu kurekhoda imiphumela; akudlulisi imali noma kusayini isivumelwano.
home.agreementsHint: Buyekeza imigomo, xoxisana ngezinguquko, bese sayina izivumelwano.
home.currencyMissingHint: Ungahlola izinhlangano nomsebenzi. Ukuhwebelana ngemali kuzovuleka lapho imali isetshenziswa.
home.financeHint: Izikhonto, imithetho yemali, namanye amathuluzi ezimali
home.intro: Thola umsebenzi owusizo, hwebelana ngempahla nezinsizakalo, futhi uhlele nabanye.
home.marketHint: Bheka impahla nezinsizakalo, noma nikeza okwakho.
home.noWallet: Alikho iwallet elixhumene ne-akhawunti yakho kule mali.
home.organizationsHint: Thola iqembu, joyina umsebenzi walo, noma phatha inhlangano.
home.title: Umsebenzi nokuhweba
home.walletHint: Ibhala lakho, izinkokhelo, nezinto endaweni eyodwa.
home.workHint: Hlola imisebenzi evulekile ubone ukuthi izinhlangano zidingani.
joint_ledgers.co_owners_ids_label: Ama-ID eziyisikhwama zabashayeli (ahlukaniswe yikhoma noma isikhala)
joint_ledgers.how_title: Indlela ukuhamba kwemali okuhlanganyelwe okugcina ngayo
joint_ledgers.intro: I-ledger ehlanganyelwe yi-akhawunti ebashayeli abaningi: ibhalansi yayo ngeyabantu abaningi, futhi akukho kuhamba kwemali okuphuma kuyo kuze kube yilapho wonke umshayeli odingekayo evumile. Umsayini oyedwa angeke akwazi ukuhambisa imali ehlanganyelwe eyedwa — ukuhamba kwemali kuphakanyiswa, kulinde, futhi kugcinwe kuphela lapho umthentho wokuvuma we-ledger uhlanganyelwe.
joint_ledgers.money_enters_note: Imali ingena ku-ledger ehlanganyelwe ngendlela ejwayelekile: ukudlulisa okujwayelekile ku-akhawunti yayo. I-ledger igcina futhi ihambise iyunithi; ayikwazi ukuyikhipha.
joint_ledgers.movement_pending: {approvals} kwe-{needed} bavumile — kubambelele kuze kube yilapho isivumelwano siphelele.
joint_ledgers.movement_settled: Kugcinwe {when} — isivumelwano siphelele futhi imali yahamba.
joint_ledgers.new_ledger_desc: Nikeza abashayeli noguquko lokuvuma kusengaphambili. Uhlale ungumsayini we-ledger oyivulile; abanye abashayeli bajoyina ngama-ID abo eziyisikhwama — ngendlela efanayo nokuthi ukudlulisa kubaluleka umamukeli.
joint_ledgers.no_movements_before: Akukho kuhamba kwemali okwamanje. Kunoma yikuphi okusha kuzodingeka
joint_ledgers.none_yet: Akukho okwamanje — awuyena umshayeli we-ledger ehlanganyelwe, futhi ayikho evulekile kulo mhlaba.
joint_ledgers.private_note: I-ledger eyimfihlo ifundeka kuphela kubashayeli bayo — njengephepha lokuvota.
joint_ledgers.propose_note: Ukuphakamisa kuyisayina. Kugcinwa kuphela lapho umthentho uhlanganyelwe — isayina yakho eyedwa ayihambisi lutho.
joint_ledgers.public_ledger_option: Irekhodi lomphakathi — noma ubani angalibuka (isifundazwe sendawo yegunya sokuhlanganyela)
joint_ledgers.rail_1_body: Umhlali oyedwa akakwazi ukuhambisa imali ehlanganyelwe — ukuhamba kulindele ukuthi imithetho yokuvuma ihlangane.
joint_ledgers.rail_2_body: izingalo zibeka imithetho nenhloso yazo, kodwa akukho isigaba esingasusa ilungelo.
joint_ledgers.rail_2_strong: Inkululeko yokwenza isivumelwano, kodwa kukhona isisekelo.
joint_ledgers.rail_3_body: Ibhala lihlala ku-akhawunti ejwayelekile kurekhodi lomphakathi lwe-hash-chained; ukuxhasa nokuxazulula kuyizinto ezijwayelekile. Akukho mali ekhethekile ehlanganyelwe.
joint_ledgers.rail_4_body: Irekhodi elingenayo imali eyanele liyanqaba ukuhambisa imali ngendlela efanayo ne-wallet enqaba ukudonsa imali engekho.
joint_ledgers.rail_5_body: Irekhodi elihlanganyelwe liphethe futhi lihambise iyunithi; alilikhishelani.
joint_ledgers.step_propose_body: Noma yimuphi umhlali ohlanganyelwe uphonse isiphakamiso sokukhipha imali — ukukhokha, ukudlulisa, noma ukudonsa. Isiphakamiso sibalwa njengesayina yabo.
joint_ledgers.step_settle_body: Ukuvuma okuhlangana nomthetho — bonke abasayina, noma iningi, njengoba kuvunyelwe ekuvuleni — kuhambisa imali ngeso sinye.
joint_ledgers.step_wait_body: Ukuhamba kubambelele ngenkathi abanye abahlali behlanganyelwe banquma. Ukuvuma ngamunye kusekhoneni irekhodi.
joint_ledgers.title: Amarekhodi ahlanganyelwe
listing.buyers_accounts_note: Abathengi bakhonjiswa njengama-akhawunti. Uyatshelwa ukuthi iyiphi i-oda okumele uyamukele, hhayi ukuthi ubani oyifake. Ukuxazulula kuhambisa imali nento ngemuva kwenkambiso eyodwa.
listing.cgc_badge_note: Isignathi senhlalakahle yomphakathi sinikeza ulwazi: i-CGC ihweba ngemigomo efanayo nebhizinisi elizimele, hhayi ngomthetho ohlukile.
listing.listing_closed: Lolu hlu lucishiwe, noma awukabi nesikhwama salolu hlobo lemali.
listing.no_pending_orders: Azikho izオーダー ezilindile kule khasi.
listing.ordering_note: Uk-order-a akuthuthi lutho ngokwakho. Umthengisi uyavuma, bese imali nento kuyathutha ndawonye — zombili, noma akukho.
listing.org_trades: Inhlangano ihweba ngegama layo — uhlu lwayo luwisenqumo sayo somphakathi.
listing.person_account_note: Umuntu othengisayo ubonakala njengesakhawoni, hhayi igama. Ukuxhumanisa isakhawoni nomuntu akuyona into le khasi elingayenza.
market.available_items: Kunezinto {count} ezitholakala kule khasi. Okukhethile kuhlala kukhethiwe ngenkathi uhola.
market.goods_note: Imikhiqizo kumele isebenzise into onayo. Izinto ezivele sezilikhishwe kushiwo azifakwe.
market.intro: Izinto nezinsizakalo ezithengiswa, imisebenzi etholakalayo, nomakhelwane abacela usizo — ibhodi eyodwa, evulekile kuwo wonke umuntu ohlala lapha.
market.no_currency_body: Akukho okungabizwa ngamanani kuze kube isishayamthetho sasezansi salo mhlaba sithome imali.
market.opt_service: Insizakalo — isikhathi sami noma umsebenzi wami
market.search_failed: Ukusesha izinto akukwazanga ukuphothulwa. Zama futhi.
market.title: Imakethe nomsebenzi
market.wallet_see_register: ukuze ubone noma ubhalise izinto zakho.
org_settings.conversions_desc: Lapho ifomu lobuwena lishintsha, isinqumo esigunyayo siqopha inani eliphansi lemakethe elifanele nokuthi libalwe kanjani (Art. III §5). Lezoirekhodi zivela lapha.
org_settings.dues_changes_note: Ushintsho luqophelwe emlandweni walena nhlangano. Beka inani kuze kube zero ukuze ungabizi mali yomalungu.
org_settings.dues_desc: Imali yomalungu eyazithandela wukubhalisa okungumfihlo phakathi komlungu nenhlangano ekhethayo ukuyibiza. Imali yomalungu iwukuzibophezela kokulunga — akulona neze intela, akulona neze isabelo. Ikhokhelwa njengokudlulisa okujwayelekile kusuka ewallet yomlungu uqobo.
org_settings.intro: Buka imali yomalungu, amasheya, namairekhodi ezezimali ale nhlangano. Ummeli wayo angashintsha imali yomalungu futhi akhuphe amasheya enhlangano yamasheya.
org_settings.issue_shares_note: Khetha umamukeli futhi ufake amayunithi amasha. Lokhu kwengeza ubuwena bomphakathi futhi kushintshe amaphesenti obuwena akhona.
org_settings.ledger_desc: Buka ibhala lenhlangano nomlando wokukhokha. Amanye amaphathi abonakala nge-akhawunti ukuze kuvikelwe ubumfihlo bezezimali bawo.
org_settings.ledger_restricted: I-ledger ye-wallet nemali yentela ibonakala kummeli wenhlangano nebhodi yayo ehleli isihlalo.
org_settings.levies_restricted: Izicelo zokukhokha zibonakala kummeli wenhlangano kanye nebhodi ehleli isihlalo.
org_settings.no_account: Le nhlangano ayikabi nayo i-akhawunti yezimali — ivulwa lapho inhlangano iqala ukwenza izinkambiso.
org_settings.no_ownership_entries: Azikho izincwadi zobunikazi kuleli khasi. Buyela ekhasini lokuqala ukuze uvuselele.
org_settings.no_recipients: Akukho abamukeli bahambisana nalokhu kuleli khasi.
org_settings.rail_gate_body: Akukho malungiso angahambisana nokuvota, ukuba umkhethwa, ukuhlala, noma ukwenza isicelo (Art. I · Art. II §8).
org_settings.rail_gate_strong: Alukaze kube khona isivimbelo sokusebenzisa ilungelo.
org_settings.rail_optin_body: Ilungu lihlanganyela futhi lihambe ngokukhululeka; uma amalungiso ephela, ubulungu buyaphela — alikho ilungelo elivimbwa.
org_settings.rail_paid_body: Amalungu akhokha amalungiso ngesikhathi ngasinye. Ukukhokha akukwenzeki ngokuzenzakalelayo.
org_settings.search_by_name: Sesha ngegama lomphakathi ukuze ukhethe umuntu noma inhlangano.
org_settings.share_units_help: Inani elihle elinezigaba zama-decimal ezifika kusithupha. Le senzo asigcini ukukhokha.
org_settings.shares_entry_note: Ukuqala ngasinye kuwuhlanga olulodwa lokuba ngumnikazi olurekhodiwe. Umnikazi angaba nezinhlanga eziningi.
org_settings.shares_note_after: — akukaze kube yimali (lokhu kugcinelwe indawo yegunya ebanzi kakhulu, Art. V §5). Ukuba ngumnikazi kuyiqiniso lomphakathi elirekhodiwe ngegama; imali eshintshayo lapho isabelo sidayiswa ihlala irekhodi lewallet eyimfihlo.
org_settings.taxes_desc: Lokhu inhlangano ekumembelele futhi ekuhloliswe ngaphansi komthetho wezimali zomphakathi (Art. V §4). Indlela isikhokelo esibalwa ngayo — isisekelo nesilinga saso — kuyimfihlo yomphakathi.
org_settings.title: {name} — izimali
request_detail.after_applying_body: Inhlangano ibuyekeza isicelo sakho bese ikunikeza imigomo. Uyavuma bese usayina njengosebenzi, bese inhlangano isayina ukuze ivule isivumelwano somsebenzi. Imigomo ihlala iyimfihlo.
request_detail.apply_note: Wena nenhlangano kuphela eningafunda isicelo sakho. Ukufaka isicelo akudali inkontileka.
request_detail.before_apply_prefix: Udinga i-akhawunti yemali yalo mhlaba ukuze ufake isicelo. Hlola
request_detail.closed_body: Le nhlangano ayisathatha izicelo zalolu msebenzi.
request_detail.codetermination_note: Umsebenzi oqhubekayo ubalwa ekumeleleni kwabasebenzi. Imithetho yale nhlangano inikeza isihlalo sokuqala somsebenzi lapho kukhona abasebenzi aba-{first} nokumeleka okulinganayo kwabasebenzi nabanikazi lapho kukhona abasebenzi aba-{parity}.
request_detail.intro: Buyekeza umsebenzi uthumele isicelo sangasese enhlanganweni.
request_detail.recorded_after: ngesimo sayo, imigomo enikeziwe nesivumelwano esiphuma kuyo.
resident_agreements.compose_intro: Bhala imigomo ubisele abanye abantu ukuba basayine.
resident_agreements.no_matching: Alikho ikhona elihambisana no “{query}”. Zama omunye uqalo.
resident_agreements.privacy_note: Imigomo iyimfihlo kubaphathi. Wonke amaphathi kumele asayine, futhi kungekho mthetho ongashiya ilungelo lomthethosisekelo.
resident_agreements.review_intro: Buyekeza imigomo, izigxivikizi kanye nezinguquko eziphakanyiswe nabanye abahlangani.
resident_agreements.search_hint: Faka isiqalo segama lomuntu. Abahlangani abakhethiwe bahlala bakhethiwe lapho usesha futhi.
resident_agreements.search_to_find: Sesha ukuze uthole abantu okumele ubameme.
stipend.classes_desc: I-bump ihambisana neqiniso ngokuthi umuntu wenza what — hhayi ukuthi ungubani. Ukubeka iminingi ngeke kwedlele i-cap engu {cap}.
stipend.examples_desc: Ifloor efanayo kubo bonke; umehluko usezingamehluko emisebenzi kuphela. Lokhu kubalwa ifomula esebenzayo ezibonisweni zemisebenzi — lokhu kuziboniso, hhayi ireisithi yomuntu.
stipend.formula_line1: inani = floor + min( Σ eligible-role bumps, cap )
stipend.intro: Umehluko, hhayi iholo. Wonke umuntu ohambisana nokuhlala uthola ifloor efanayo; phezu kwalokho, labo abenza imisebenzi ethile bathola i-bump encane yokubonga. Ngoba iholo ngeke kube isifanekiso sokufaneleka esihlalweni, umehluko uyengeza kuphela, unomkhawulo, futhi ubhala irekhodi eyimfihlo kuphela — awuniki isihlalo, ukuvota, noma inzuzo.
stipend.k_anon_note: Inani eliphelele nenani labantu kuphela okushicilelwayo. Isigaba esinabantu abaphansi kwangu {floor} sihlanganiswa nenani jikelele futhi asishicilelwa sodwa — isigaba esincane singaveza amalungu aso.
stipend.no_run_yet: Akukaze kube nokusebenza — inani elihlangene lizavela kokokuqala.
stipend.node_operator_basis: Gcina i-node yalo mhlaba isebenza — umsebenzi we-infrastructure.
stipend.numbers_desc_after: — iningi elikhethekile lasekamheni KANYE nokuvuma kwabantu abalawulwa yikho. Ngoba imali yabavoti uqobo yona esetshenziswayo, kumele bavumelane.
stipend.numbers_desc_before: Izixazululo zamanje, ezirekhodiwe. Akekho oluzishintshayo esikrinini sezilungiselelo: yinye ngayinye ishintsha kuphela lapho
stipend.office_holder_basis: Uphethe isikhundla somphakathi — isishayamthetho, isigungu esiphethe, ijaji, ibhodi.
stipend.office_holder_who: Wonke umphathi weqhaza lomphakathi, hhayi isiqila. Ukwenyusa kuphela ngosuku kuphela lapho umsebenzi uphela.
stipend.private_receipt_body: Inani lomuntu ngamunye libhalwa kuphela ewallet yakhe eyimfihlo.
stipend.propose_note: Lokhu kudweba isiphakamiso sekamheni (F-LEG-031). Akukaze kusindise isilungiselelo esivamile.
stipend.short_paid: Lokhu kuhamba kwakhokhelwa kancane: itrezhari ibingakwazi ukulikhokhela ngokuphelele, ngakho wonke umuntu uthole ingxenye efanayo — hhayi abaqala u-N emugqeni.
stipend.switched_off_body: Isishayamthetho sicishile isisizelo ngesinqumo. Ifomula engaphansi yilena engasebenza ukuba sikhishwe kabusha — ukucisha uqobo kwakho kuyisinqumo sesishayamthetho, hhayi isilungiselelo esishintshwa noma ubani.
stipend.title: Isisizelo somphakathi
stipend.who_receives_body: Isesango elifanayo elivula ukuvota nokuba umkhethwa: ilungelo eliphelele, akukho ukuhlola imali, akukho isicelo, akukho zifanekiso zanoma yiluphi uhlobo.
stipend.who_receives_strong: Ubani owamukelayo — ukuhlala, futhi akukho okunye.
treasury.choose_inside: Khetha indawo kule ndawo yegunya ukuze uhlole izimali zayo zomphakathi.
treasury.intro: Bheka izibalo zomphakathi, izinhlelo zezimali nemali engenayo yendawo. Incwadi yezibalo zemali ikhombisa ama-akhawunti ngaphandle kokukhomba abantu abangemuva kwawo.
treasury.issuance_covers: Umlando wokukhipha imali uhlanganisa yonke imali.
treasury.last_report: Umbiko wokugcina wemali ophothulwe: {when}. Lezi zibalo zihlanganisa yonke imali, kuhlanganise nezindawo ezinye.
treasury.ledger_appendonly: Okubhalwe encwadini yezibalo kwengezwa kuphela futhi kuhambisana ne-hash. Le khasi likhombisa ukuhamba okurekhodiwe; aluhengi ukuqinisekisa i-chain.
treasury.ledger_empty_choose: Khetha i-akhawunti yomphakathi, noma ubheke zonke izakhawunti zemali.
treasury.ledger_scope_currency: Ukuhamba kwawo wonke ama-akhawunti kule mali, kuhlanganise nama-akhawunti ezomnotho angasebenzisi amagama angempela.
treasury.next_disbursement: Ukukhishwa okulandelayo kwesamba somphakathi kulindeleleke ngo {when}.
treasury.no_accounts: Azikho izibalo zomphakathi kule khasi kule ndawo.
treasury.no_borrowing: Azikho irekhodi zokuboleka kule khasi kule ndawo.
treasury.no_budgets: Azikho izinhlelo zokusebenza kule khasi kule ndawo.
treasury.no_currency_body: Ayikho imali yomphakathi okumele ibalwe kuze kube khona imali yohlobo oluthile.
treasury.no_report: Alikho irekhodi lomalise lomalise eliphelele. Izimali zisonke zivela ngemuva kokuphela kwerekhodi.
treasury.no_revenue: Azikho izimithombo yengeniso kule khasi kule ndawo.
treasury.no_spending_lines: Azikho imigqa yokusebenzisa imali kule khasi.
treasury.report_failed: Irekhodi lakugcina alizange liqedwe; zonke izimali ezibonakalayo zivela erekhodini lakugcina eliphelele.
treasury.select_budget: Khetha uhlelo lokusebenza ukuze ufunde imigqa yokusebenzisa imali.
treasury.select_revenue: Khetha umthombo wengeniso ukuze ufunde izimali zentela.
treasury.title: Ezimali zomphakathi
units.clock_note: Iwashi lomnotho lihamba ngomjikelezo we {interval}; ukukhishwa okulandelayo kulindeleleke ngo {when}.
units.collected_from: Koqokwe kusuka ku-{from} kuya ku-{to}. ukuvuselela kwenza le repothi eqedile ihlale ibonakala kuze kube isikhathi sokuba inkophi ihlelele.
units.collection_stopped: Ukuqoqwa kumile. Qhubeka ukuze uqale lapho kwamiswa khona esinyathelweni sokugcina esigcinwe.
units.intro: Bheka imali, imithetho yayo ebhalwe phansi, nerepothi yemali yakamuva eqedile.
units.issued_by: Ikhishwe ngu-{issuer} — imali igcinwe ngumsingi (Art. V §5).
units.levers_note: Yinye yalezi ingashintshwa kuphela isinqumo esidlulile, esibhalwe phansi emphakathini, futhi kuphela ngaphansi kwemingcele ebonakalayo. Alikho izindlela zokuyisetha ngqo — hhayi kumsebenzi, hhayi kumphathi, futhi hhayi kule phage.
units.no_levers: Azikho izikhali zemali ezichaziwe kuleli zwe.
units.no_subdivisions: Azikho izinhlangano ezincane ezichaziwe — i-{unit} yonke iyona kuphela isilinganiso esibhalwe phansi. Isishayamthetho siningisa ngokwesinqumo, njengazo zonke izikhali zemali.
units.precision_note: Kuboniswa izindawo zama-decimal ezi-{precision}. Ibhuku lezimali ligcina okuningi kunalokho ngaphakathi, ngakho akukho okulahleka ngokulungisa izibalo — kuphela kufihliwe ekubonakaleni.
units.rates_note: Zombili ziyizinhloso ezibekwa isishayamthetho, hhayi amandla emvelo. Nganoma iyiphi ingashintshwa isinqumo, ngaphansi kwemingcele engayidluli.
units.report_desc: Lezi zibalo zichaza izibalo. Izikhala ziqoqwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngenkathi ukuhwebelana kuqhubeka; akukona ukuhlanganisa okusheshayo kwebhuku lezimali. Irepothi ayishintshi imali noma izinga.
units.subdivisions_desc: Indlela iyunithi ehlukaniseka ngayo incishwa isishayamthetho, njengoba kwenziwa izisindo nezilinganiso. Ukuhlukaniseka okubizwa ngegama kuyindlela yokubonisa kuleda lokuqopha olulodwa — akulona imali yesibili.
units.telemetry_note: Ishumi eliphezulu lisebenzisa izibalo ezixhunyiwe eziqoqwe kule ngothi. Ukushintsha kusebenzisa ukudluliselwa okuqophiwe ezinsukwini ezingu-30 eziphela lapho ukuqoqwa kuqala. Akukho mnikazi we-akhawunti noma indawo eveziwe.
units.title: Iyunithi nemali
wallet.caption_assets: Izinto kwi-akhawunti yakho kule khasi, ngokulandelana kwamagama
wallet.divides_after: — izindlela zokubonisa kuleda lokuqopha olulodwa, akulona imali yesibili.
wallet.find_item_label: Thola into ngokusebenzisa isiqalo segama layo
wallet.intro: Lokho okuphethe, nokuthi kuvelaphi. Le khasi ngelakho wedwa — izibalo ziyimfihlo njengoba iphepha lokuvota kungnjalo, futhi akekho omunye ongazibona.
wallet.make_note: Ukubhalisa into kunika leyo nto ubuntu bayo nokurekhoda imvelaphi yayo — zonke izandla edlula kuzigcinwa. Ngemva kwalokho ungaynikela emakethe.
wallet.no_currency_body: Isishayamthetho sokuqala salo mhlaba asikabhali lutho, ngakho akukho okungaphethwa.
wallet.no_items_start: Azikho izinto eziqala ngo “{query}”. Zama okunye noma ususe ukusesha.
wallet.no_subdivisions: Azikho izinhlukumezi ezichazwe okwamanje — indlela iyunithi ehlukaniseka ngayo ngamandla esishayamthetho okulinganisa.
wallet.no_wallet_body: Iwallet iyavuleka lapho ukuhlala kwakho kuqinisekiswa. Uma usanda kwazisa lapho uhlala khona, izofika lapho kuza ukuqinisekisa.
wallet.search_failed: Ukusesha izinto akukwazanga ukuphothulwa. Zama futhi.
wallet.send_note: Uthumela ku-akhawunti, hhayi egameni — ngendlela efanayo nephepha lokuvota elihlukaniswe nomvoti. Alikho itulo: ukuthumela okungaphezulu kokuphethe kuyenqaba, akubolekwa.
wallet.title: Isipha sami
wallet.your_account_after: — i-id omunye odingayo ukuze ukuthumelele imali.
work.accepting_note: Ukukuvuma kusayina lezi zimo njengomsebenzi. Umsebenzi uba semsebenzini ngemuva kokuba inhlangano isayine.
work.applications_hint: Bheka isincomo somfaki sesicelo bese unikeza imigomo ephelele. Umfaki sesicelo kumele amukele ngaphambi kokuba usayine isivumelwano.
work.choose_posting: Khetha isaziso ukuze ubheke izicelo zaso.
work.closing_note: Ukuvala kumeza izicelo ezintsha nokwamukelwa kwezinhlelo ezisasebenza.
work.complete_offer_hint: Faka inkokhelo, imali, imisebenzi nes케juli. Imigomo ethunyelwe ayikwazi ukulungiswa; umsebenzi ukhetha ukuthi uyayiamukela yini.
work.intro: Bheka izicelo, vunyelana ngemigomo, bese ulandela isivumelwano somsebenzi ngemisebenzi yezigayina zombili.
work.manage_hiring_note: Ungakwazi ukuphatha ukuqasha ezinhlanganweni lapho ungummele wamanje.
work.no_orgs: Azikho izinhlangano kuleli khasi. Ukuqasha kudinga indima yommele wenhlangano wamanje.
work.title: Umsebenzi wami nokuqasha
work.work_terms_hint: Faka imisebenzi, inkokhelo nomuhlobo wayo (noma uthi akukhokhelwa), isikhathi nanoma yiziphi ezinye izimo. Lezi mininingwane ivela esikhundleni somphakathi.
